rows.en: －　Corridor　－＝－　Riko is waiting for someone　－
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０１０What's taking so long...
What are you doing here?
Waiting for someone?
What are you doing here?
Waiting for someone?
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０１１Eeeeeek!!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０１２Geez, don't scare me like that!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０１３Yikes!!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０１４Ugh, geez,￥don't sneak up on me like that!￥You startled me!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０１５I've been waiting all this time,￥and that's how you show up?!＝...
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０１６What's with that weird face...＝＠１０１＿０１７You! I mean YOU!￥I was waiting for YOU!!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０１８I've got something to tell you.￥But not here...
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０１９Let's see... we'll go to￥your room!
Don't decide for me.
Then let's go to yours.
Don't decide for me.
Then let's go to yours.
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０２０What are you talking about?!＝＠１０１＿０２１I'm going out of my way￥to come to YOUR room,￥you know?!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０２２Come on,￥look a little happier about it!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０２３Wh-what are you saying?!＝＠１０１＿０２４If you think I'd let you into￥my room that easily,￥you're dead wrong!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０２５If the day ever comes when you￥get in, it'll be after I've left￥for Elan!!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０２６Ugh, enough!￥We're wasting time￥arguing about this!!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿０２７Come on, let's go!
－　；'s Room　－
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿００１Geez... your room is so tidy￥it's almost neurotic. You might￥give Kairi a run for his money.
So what did you want?
Don't snoop around...
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿００２You don't have to say￥it like that!!
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿００３I came all the way to your room,￥and you're not happy about it?!
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿００４Oh, shut up!
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿００５Honestly!￥You're a guy, so quit whining￥about every little thing!
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿００６Geez... your room is so tidy￥it's almost obnoxious! I guess￥it shows your personality?
So what did you want?
Don't touch my stuff...
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿００７You don't have to say￥it like that!!
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿００８I came all the way to your room,￥and you're not happy about it?!
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿００９Oh, shut up!
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿０１０Honestly!! Are you neurotic or￥something?! Quit whining about￥every little thing!
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿０１１Geez, and here I was waiting￥because I had something I really￥wanted you to hear!
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿０１２Well, whatever...￥Just sit quietly and listen.
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿０１３I hate putting it this way, but￥my family is what people call a￥"distinguished house."
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿０１４But you know,￥growing up there, all I had￥around me...
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿０１５...were people who only wanted￥something from my family. No one￥cared about me.＝＠１０２＿０１６The people who were kind to me,￥the ones who called me cute...
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿０１７I realized none of them were￥really seeing me.＝＠１０２＿０１８I figured as long as I stayed￥in that world, people would￥always look at me that way.
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿０１９But you always looked at me￥without any prejudice.＝＠１０２＿０２０At the real me.
Did I?
I didn't do anything.
Did I?
I didn't do anything.
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿０２１It's so like you not to notice.
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿０２２I see... For you,￥that was just a natural￥thing to do...＝＠１０２＿０２３You're the first person￥who's ever been like that.
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿０２４Right. For you, that was￥just the natural thing.
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿０２５But for me,￥it was really special.
＊Riko＊＠１０２＿０２６For someone like me, who's lived￥surrounded by prejudice...
＊Riko＊＠１０３＿００１From now on I want to be someone￥who looks past the surface and￥sees who people really are.＝＠１０３＿００２You always did that,￥didn't you?
＊Riko＊＠１０３＿００３That's why, at first... even￥when I was so nasty to you, you￥still treated me normally.
＊Riko＊＠１０３＿００４Maybe it's thanks to you...￥that I could change how I think.
You did that yourself.
Oh... thank you.
You did that yourself.
Oh... thank you.

＊Riko＊＠１０３＿００５You think so? But if you hadn't￥been here, I'd have just been a￥nasty person.＝＠１０３＿００６I'd never have learned to care￥about others, and maybe never￥realized I was wrong.＝＠１０３＿００７So I really mean it now.￥I'm glad I met you...

＊Riko＊＠１０３＿００８I'm the one who should be￥thanking you.＝＠１０３＿００９If I'd never met you, I'd have￥just been a nasty person.＝＠１０３＿０１０You made me see that,￥so for once,￥I should be honest.＝＠１０３＿０１１Thank you.￥Really.￥I'm glad I met you.
＊Riko＊＠１０３＿０１２Right now...￥I've started thinking￥seriously about Elan.＝＠１０３＿０１３I just wonder what kind of￥planet it is. I want to see￥it for myself.
＊Riko＊＠１０３＿０１４And...￥if it's with you,￥I wouldn't mind going.
＊Riko＊＠１０３＿０１５B-but don't get the wrong idea!
＊Riko＊＠１０３＿０１６It's just that with you, I doubt￥I'd get bored, no matter￥what planet it is!!
